newsitem.title: USA: PECO shuts Limerick 2 nuke, restart unknown.
newsitem.headline: PECO shuts Limerick 2 nuke, restart unknown.

text.p: PECO Energy Co's 1,055 megawatt (MW) Limerick 2 nuclear power unit in Pottstown, Pa., was manually shut late Friday after operators detected an oil leak, the company said Monday.
The unit was taken off line at 2337 EST Friday when an oil leak was detected "with the electric hydraulic control system for the turbine," company spokesman Michael Wood said.
The company could not yet comment on a restart date for the unit.
Next-day electricity peak prices at the Pennsylvania-New Jersey-Maryland Interconnect (PJM) were mostly higher early Monday to the $26.75-27.50 per megawatt hour (MWh) range, traders said.
